# Teri Eyenike

> Personal portfolio of Teri Eyenike, a software engineer in Nigeria. The site shares selected software projects, technical writing, résumé, and contact information.

Teri builds web pages, applications, and developer tools. Teri is open to software engineering roles and collaboration in technical writing, consulting, and building company web pages.

## About

- [Homepage](https://www.iamteri.tech/): Overview of Teri's work and current opportunities.
- [About](https://www.iamteri.tech/about/): Background, focus areas, and tools.
- [Résumé](https://www.iamteri.tech/resume/): Experience, education, and selected work.
- [Contact](https://www.iamteri.tech/contact/): Contact options for roles and collaboration.

## Selected work

- [Projects](https://www.iamteri.tech/projects/): Portfolio projects and links to their demos or source code.
- [Waitlist App](https://waitlist-app-vert.vercel.app/): Xata hackathon-winning Next.js waitlist project. [Source code](https://github.com/Terieyenike/xata-with-nextjs).
- [Track Trips](https://tracktrips-app.vercel.app/): Travel journal and trip planner. [Source code](https://github.com/Terieyenike/track-trips).
- [Smart Shopping List](https://github.com/the-collab-lab/tcl-49-smart-shopping-list): Team-built shopping list application.
- [Caption Image](https://caption-image-gamma.vercel.app/): AI-assisted image captioning application. [Client source](https://github.com/Terieyenike/caption-image-client) and [server source](https://github.com/Terieyenike/caption-image-server).
- [File Organizer](https://pypi.org/project/py-file-organizer/): Python command-line tool published on PyPI. [Source code](https://github.com/Terieyenike/py-file-organizer).

## Documentation and technical writing

- [Blog](https://www.iamteri.tech/blog/): Technical articles and practical guides.
- [How to Build a Quiz App With Nuxt and Xata](https://thenewstack.io/how-to-build-a-quiz-app-with-nuxt-and-xata/): Hands-on guide published by The New Stack.
- [Display AI-Generated Images in a Jupyter Notebook](https://thenewstack.io/display-ai-generated-images-in-a-jupyter-notebook/): Tutorial published by The New Stack.
- [Building an AI Voice Application in Streamlit using OpenAI](https://dev.to/terieyenike/building-a-voice-transcription-and-translation-app-with-openai-whisper-and-streamlit-43mm): Tutorial published on DEV Community.

There is no separate documentation portal on this portfolio. For implementation details and project-specific documentation, use the source repositories linked under Selected work.
